𝗗𝗨𝗕𝗘𝗬 𝟭𝟰/𝟵𝟬! 🔥

Harsh Dubey took 9-53 and 5-37 as Vidarbha beat Madhya Pradesh by an innings and 20 runs.

A 14-wicket Ranji match haul 👏
